source.description: Full Moon photograph taken 10-22-2010 from Madison, Alabama, USA. Photographed with a Celestron 9.25 Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope. Acquired with a Canon EOS Rebel T1i (EOS 500D), 20 images stacked to reduce noise. 200 ISO 1/640 sec.

images.processing: Cropped to the body's extent and resized; colours unchanged.
notes: Earth-based photograph through a 235 mm (9.25-inch) Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope.
Shows a full Moon; the real phase on any given night will differ.

source.description: This full-disc image of Jupiter was taken on 21 April 2014 with Hubble's Wide Field Camera 3 (WFC3).

images.processing: Cropped to the body's extent and resized; colours unchanged.
notes: Hubble Space Telescope image (2014). Far sharper than any ground-based view; the Lab blurs it to your calculated resolution.
Cloud bands and the Great Red Spot change over time and with Jupiter's rotation.

images.processing: Cropped to the body's extent and resized; colours unchanged.

source.description: DSS2 Red + DSS2 Blue photographic survey, 4° × 4° gnomonic cutout centred on the target.
